description: Return the full details of one RoutersUA product (description, specifications, photos, price in UAH, availability, backorder ship date when on backorder) with a photo attached as an image and a cart_url that opens the store checkout with one piece of it in the cart; price and availability are read live. Use it when the user names one product or after routersua_search_products; for two or more products side by side use routersua_compare_products, and for several products or quantities in one cart routersua_create_cart_link. Pass product as the slug from search results, the model code (GL-MT6000), the store code (RUA-GL-MT6000) or the GTIN. An unknown product returns an error listing every valid slug.

product.description: One product: a slug from search results, a model code such as GL-MT6000 or GL-E750V2, a store code such as RUA-GL-MT6000, or a 13-digit GTIN; case does not matter.

name: routersua_get_product
title: Get RoutersUA product details
